And 3 Others
Counsel for Applicant :- Bharat Kumar Dixit

Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Pankaj Bhatia,J.
1. Heard learned counsel for the applicant, learned AGA and perused the record.
No one appears for the opposite party no.2 despite notice.

2. The accused-applicant seeks bail in Case Crime No.111 of 2024 under sections 363, 366, 376(3)
IPC and section 5L/6 POCSO Act, P.S. Deeh, District Rae Bareli.
3. The FIR in question was lodged as a missing person report on 24.03.2024 alleging that the daughter of the informant was enticed away by the applicant on 23.03.2024.
In the statement under section 164 Cr.P.C., the victim stated that she had gone along with the applicant to Hyderabad as per Abdul Jaleel vs State Of U.P. Thru Prin. Secy. Home, Lko.

entities.text: Abdul Jaleel vs State Of U.P. Thru Prin. Secy. Home, Lko
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 1 own free will and stayed there about sixteen days as husband and wife and physical relations were also formed with consent
. The tentative age of the victim is around 16 years.
4. Considering the statement under section 164 Cr.P.C. not corroborating the prosecution story, the applicant who has no criminal history and is in custody since 12.04.2024 is entitled for the bail.
Thus the bail application is allowed.

5. Let the applicant Abdul Jaleel be released on bail in aforesaid first information report number subject to his furnishing a personal bond and two reliable sureties of Rs.20,000/- (Twenty Thousand) each of the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned with the following conditions:
(a) The applicant shall execute a bond to undertake to attend the hearings;
(b) The applicant shall not commit any offence similar to the offence of which he is accused or suspected of the commission; and (c) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
Order Date :- 14.8.2024 VNP/-
